## Foundation Apps

### TC-S LifeLens
URL: https://ia-rl-v-1--tdfranklin101.replit.app/
Info Page: https://www.thecurrentsee.org/lifelens.html
Description: AI-powered item identification system with Robbins Maslow needs hierarchy guidance
Capabilities:
- Identify items from photos and descriptions
- Condition assessment and practical notes
- Market pricing context and value bands
- Robbins Maslow needs hierarchy mapping (needs vs wants analysis)
- Decision confidence scoring
- Regret-minimizing recommendations
Framework: Combines Maslow's hierarchy of needs with Tony Robbins' six human needs
UIM Service: lifelens-item-analyzer
Version: 1.0.0

## Robbins Maslow Needs Framework (Used by LifeLens)
Maslow's Hierarchy:
1. Physiological needs (food, water, shelter)
2. Safety and security
3. Love and belonging
4. Esteem and recognition
5. Self-actualization

Tony Robbins' Six Human Needs:
1. Certainty - Security and predictability
2. Variety - Change and stimulation
3. Significance - Feeling important and unique
4. Connection - Love and bonding
5. Growth - Personal development
6. Contribution - Giving beyond oneself
